scope: An explicit registered subset of ordinary source HTTP streams after route repair. Not all service requests, a model adoption census or a new model case.
registry_boundary: Only already named event files are read. Several earlier later-stage correction streams and one later selected-source review remain excluded. The private full registry is retained; no total is inferred for excluded streams.
read_boundary: Bounded event-file reads are non-atomic. Actual POST_BEGIN and ATTEMPT_END are paired; CLI launches, queued work, agents, preparation and backoff are not counted as live POST intervals.
Runtime: Common EVENTS registry and independent native END UTC are NOT_HELD; global Runtime POST/END/current/peak remain UNKNOWN.
native_tool_mode_separate: Two already frozen native trials recorded 38/38 and 80/80 POST/END. They are not added to ordinary source counts or peaks, and were not rescanned for this observation.
limits: Stop and length classify transport completion only. Counts and interval union do not establish semantic acceptance, server capacity, owner active labor, runtime adoption or speed.
